name: Zhengzhou Jiean Hi-Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhengzhou Jiean Hi-Tech Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and technical services of computer simulation training systems in rail transit, emergency safety, aviation, navigation, and other fields in China. It focuses on system simulation, virtual reality, and augmented reality technology in the field of virtual simulation education and training. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Zhengzhou, China.
